github.fix: Reuse canonical getGitHubToken and exact owner/provider authority. Pin the selected envelope/revision for the read lifetime, validate immediately before each GET and after the bounded response body, refuse redirects, and revalidate before returning a complete snapshot. A changed read cannot reacquire a replacement credential or fall back to cached/browser data. A provider401/403 invalidates the complete snapshot and aborts outstanding read requests instead of skipping a denied blob.

preview.fix: Existing signed-grant resolver retained. Explicit HTTP request header allowlist excludes platform bearer/API/cookie/user headers. No target redirects are followed, foreign/metadata redirects are rejected. Active HTTP/WS streams revalidate every second, fail closed on failed lookup or five-second read deadline. Both WebSocket directions revalidate before forwarding, preserve message order/binary data and bound queued/buffered data and frame size to 1 MiB. Require origin-form paths before constructing HTTP or WebSocket destinations.
